scope: Partial Unreal runtime comparison. These observations are not Python reset state or policy inputs.

stages.final_presentation_pop: Before Snowfield and Grassland region bounds changes
stages.saved_grass_population: Current saved Snowfield and Grassland bounds, with changed Grassland founder placement

sampling: Authority seconds 1, 1800 and 3600 from runs with 121 samples. Population is the sampled live roster. Log-derived birth, death and food events depend on logger coverage. Switches count successive logged sources for the same animal, without attributing cause.

logged_shared_patch_payments.scope: Successes with identical printed patch ID and timestamp, in log order. Runtime birth does not imply the individual was still juvenile. No unsuccessful attempts or same-step causal ordering are inferred from this summary.

meal_scope: The current stage includes positive Eco Fauna meal lines. First timed is the earliest explicitly timestamped line. Untimed payments can predate it. Native deer region intake and wolf carcass reservations are separate sources and do not give per-agent first meal timestamps.

golden_eagle_hunt_audit.scope: Current saved baseline with hunt audit enabled. Rejections count checks; diagnostic and long-run trajectories may differ.

highland_rat_cover_trial.scope: PIE-only relocated rats and temporary boulder sight setting. Tracked rays exclude heading, hunger and decision timing. Plant payments are a sampled lower bound.

rule_fauna_shelter_inventory.scope: Positive shelter radius is required for a rule-fauna shelter target. Rock occlusion and native deer refuges have separate runtime paths.

rat_refuge_destination_trial.scope: PIE-only. Both arms debit 0.125 authored capacity from UplandForbs and apply identical site geometry. The target uses a deliberately oversized entrance to retain normal capture checks; it is a means to test target selection.

rat_refuge_approach_trial.scope: PIE-only. Same refuge geometry and stock. Static approach enables existing ShelterApproach only, via mask 16. Query positions are sampled after the decision, so they are not individual decision receipts.

rat_refuge_entrance_trial.scope: PIE-only same approach rule. EntranceRadius is a predator eligibility threshold for the refuge area. There is no physical entrance collision or prey body-fit check on traversal.
rat_refuge_entrance_trial.capture_context_scope: Last sampled live position is paired with the authority death log. The sample is an observation and does not give the coordinates at final contact.
